requirements.actor: Any public visitor
requirements.trigger: The visitor opens /jw-stone or an existing JW profile destination

requirements.constraints: The new route is standalone, reachable, canonical, and has no presentation migration or redirect from the existing profile.
requirements.negative: No code may switch, restyle, redirect, or mutate /u/jw-stone, the JW custom-domain profile, profile editing, inventory routes, or database presentation settings.
requirements.unchanged: All current JW profile appearance, behavior, editing, inventory, Direct Connect, and custom-domain routing remain unchanged.
requirements.acceptance: Route and regression tests distinguish /jw-stone from every existing profile route and the rendered application confirms the separation.
requirements.proof: App routing tests, server route tests, profile regression tests, source diff review, and desktop/mobile route captures.

requirements.actor: Fabricators, builders, designers, and homeowners

requirements.unchanged: Existing profile discovery and search behavior outside /jw-stone remains unchanged.
requirements.acceptance: Tests prove initial inventory, one-click detail access, independent URL round trips, invalid-state recovery, and optional refinements without a staged dependency.
requirements.proof: State parser unit tests, component journey tests, and desktop/mobile browser journeys.

requirements.negative: A path cannot become a product, workspace, questionnaire, filter, page replacement, contact action, audience-specific catalog, or claim of suitability, popularity, live availability, future supply, origin, performance, or preference.
